text:
alex: quick async check — i'm putting together a small change to the dashboard metric doc for TTFT. current panel uses client-side model tokens emitted + network time which double-counts some latency. want to align on spec: TTFT should be server-first-byte (edge) → token-emit delta, not client render time. thoughts?

maria: +1 on using server-first-byte. that's what infra traces show is the meaningful SLO. can we also clarify windowing? are we doing a rolling p95 over 5m or a snapshot daily p95 for alerts? :thinking_face: 

kevin: for SLO alerts i'd keep 5m p95 for realtime and 1h p95 as a backup to avoid noisy alerts. for historical trend panels use 6h/24h. also we should normalize by sequence length for tok/s panels — otherwise the busy long-context jobs skew the rate.

sara: re: normalization — do we want tok/s as tokens_emitted / active_gpu_seconds or tokens_emitted / request_active_seconds? i've seen both. request_active_seconds includes queue/wait which blurs raw throughput.

alex: good question. proposal: two separate panels —
- tok/s_throughput = tokens_emitted / request_active_seconds (shows end-to-end throughput)
- kernels_tok/s = tokens_emitted / exec_seconds (only execution time on device)
this helps root-cause (queue vs kernel).

perf-bot: note: i just ran the regression check that @alex requested — baseline vs canary for last 6h shows a 7% drop in kernels_tok/s for model-x-qa-canary at longer seq lengths (>=1024). full diff: https://perf.internal/reports/1782

kevin: thanks perf-bot. alex — can you open a small PR to change the dashboard queries + add the exec_seconds panel? i can review. include the promql/ clickhouse snippets so alerts can be updated.

alex: will do. putting the suggested PromQL here so we can sanity-check before PR: 

```promql
# server-first-byte TTFT per request (p95 over 5m)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(server_first_byte_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))

# tokens per exec-second (kernels_tok/s) aggregated per model
sum(rate(model_tokens_emitted_total[5m])) by (model) / sum(rate(model_exec_seconds_total[5m])) by (model)
```

maria: those look good. one nit: for histograms we also have to ensure we use the same label set (region,tier). add `by (model, region)` when relevant.

alex: good call. i'll include region+tier. also adding a panel description: "TTFT = time from server first byte to first generated token; use server-side timestamp to avoid client rendering variance."

kevin: ping me when PR is up. i'll also run a focused profiler on the canary job for seq>=1024 to see kernel-level hotspots (cuda kernel durations + memcpy).

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: alex/ttft-metrics-fix -> staging at 2028-06-10T02:30Z :rocket:

alex: thanks — i'll open the PR in 15m. if anyone has quick objections speak now, otherwise i'll proceed. :thumbsup:

sara: no objections. cheers.

kevin: ack.
